theme: A clear day for the job search and a couple of travel locks.
greeting: Nothing's on the calendar today, Dan, so the day is yours. Tomorrow brings the Brunswick recruiter call at 11 — worth arriving ready.

needsAttention.title: Pick a time with Carol Hansell
needsAttention.detail: Carol replied this evening — flexible tomorrow except 11:30 to 12:30, and asked you to name a time so she can send a link. The governance-network catch-up you've been trying to reconnect on since before Croatia.

needsAttention.title: Brunswick recruiter call at 11 AM
needsAttention.detail: Erika Maass, who leads Brunswick's senior recruitment, holds the 11 AM ET Teams invite tomorrow. Arrive with a crisp version of what you're looking for and why Brunswick.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: Household, overdue since Sep 14. A refundable full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week is the hardest rental in that market and sells out — booking now costs nothing and closes the risk.

flagged.title: Shawn Maher's replacement is hired
flagged.detail: EY's Shawn Maher replied — successor Didem Nisanci is on board; worth a note to keep the relationship warm.

flagged.title: Drew's notes on your ICGN bio
flagged.detail: Drew weighed in on the Toronto panel bio and the LinkedIn post — make it sparkle, lean into personality.

inbox.noise: Otherwise newsletters and invitations — Bloomberg, the ICGN policy digest, LinkedIn requests, retail promos.

resolved.title: Said yes to Ellen's Maine Visionaries ask
resolved.detail: Replied 'will do' to Ellen Richstone's NACD New England director-referral request.

resolved.title: Brunswick call set for Wednesday
resolved.detail: Confirmed Erika Maass's 11 AM ET invite; the scheduling's done.

Still clear, the afternoon unclaimed and yours to spend.
A quiet finish, with one call on the books for tomorrow.
